---
title: "How to participate in Ant Hunters?"
title-block-banner: false
comments: false
---

Before anything else, we recommend that you read the Sampling Protocol. If you have already done so and want to participate in the project...

Join us by indicating your information and the areas you have chosen to sample in this [form](https://forms.gle/FWMSMmFQp17Zmj9g9)

Or if you have any questions, you can contact us via {{< fa envelope >}}   [anthuntersproject\@gmail.com](mailto:anthuntersproject@gmail.com)

Thank you for your interest in helping science and discovering more about the ants in your environment! After carrying out your sampling, we will send you a certificate of participation and a small report on the ant communities obtained from your samples.
